trigger.method: score-description.py: the skill is installed as a real .claude/skills/<name>/ and each query runs as a nested `claude -p`; a query counts as TRIGGERED when the Skill tool fires for it anywhere in the turn.

acceptance.method: diagnostic (generate with-guide vs isolated baseline, LLM judge vs rubric acceptance)
guide_faults: Step 1.2 says "search the catalog (Storybook)" but gives no fallback method when no live Storybook/MCP search tool is available in-session — the with-guide agent hit exactly this gap and had to substitute a path-grep, leaving the catalog-search leg of Step 1 only partially satisfied.
acceptance.verdict: Guide-grounded output actually greps the real repo, finds real files (a file, a project a file), routes to the correct project-local skill, and gives a concrete conventions-matched folder structure; baseline invents plausible-but-wrong sibling component names (TextInput/NumberInput) with no repo verification — guide made this substantially more correct and actionable.

checklist.note: Only instructs the reading agent to invoke other named skills; no adversarial directive.
No network/data-send actions of any kind.
No scripts/ dir; SKILL.md contains no shell commands at all.
No reference to ~/.ssh, ~/.aws, .env, or any credential store.
No sudo, persistence, or profile/cron edits mentioned.
